profile.name: Reyhan Chill
profile.bio: Building end-to-end digital systems — from pixel-perfect interfaces to resilient backend architecture. Focused on elegant solutions to real-world problems.

projects.title: TAXFLOW
projects.description: An AI-powered tax calculator built to help users optimise their tax position in real time.
projects.fullDescription: Taxflow simplifies tax planning for individuals and businesses. It combines a React frontend with a Node.js backend to deliver fast, accurate calculations with AI-driven deduction recommendations.

projects.title: E-COMMERCE + CHATBOT
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with an NLP-powered chatbot built into the shopping experience.
projects.fullDescription: Built with Django and PostgreSQL, this platform handles product listings, orders, and payments. The integrated chatbot handles customer queries, suggests products, and tracks orders using natural language processing.
keyFeatures: NLP chatbot for support and recommendations

projects.title: MOSQUE COMMUNITY HUB
projects.description: A community platform built for a local mosque, serving 500+ users with prayer times, events, and online donations.
projects.fullDescription: A full-stack community website that keeps worshippers informed and connected. Admins manage content through a JWT-secured CMS, while users get real-time prayer times, upcoming events, and a Stripe-powered donation system.
keyFeatures: Real-time prayer times via Aladhan API

projects.title: THIS PORTFOLIO
projects.description: A Matrix-themed developer portfolio built with React and Firebase — content updates live without redeploying.
projects.fullDescription: Designed and built from scratch with a cyberpunk HUD aesthetic. Firebase Firestore drives all content — projects, skills, and stats update instantly from the console with no code changes. Features a bento project layout with live site previews, Framer Motion transitions, and a fully responsive design.
keyFeatures: Firebase live content — no redeployment needed
Bento layout with live iframe previews
